data.module_description: 负责湖仓中的数据清洗、结构化转换、dbt建模（Staging、DWD、DWS、ADS层）以及语义模型构建。
data.interaction: Interacts with upstream operational data stores (ODS) via schema definitions and provides structured analytical models (Staging, DWS, Marts, ADS) and semantic views consumed by data catalogs (DataHub) and BI tools.
data.implementation: Implements data cleaning, structuring, transformation, and dimensional modeling using dbt projects across Spark and Trino engines. It defines staging models for raw data normalization, incremental facts and daily summaries in marts layers, and metric specifications using MetricFlow for semantic layer consistency.

    MART_DWS --> MART_ADS[Category Revenue Rank ads_category_revenue_rank]
    MART_FACT --> SEMANTIC[Semantic Layer orders_semantic]
